organizations.publicNote: The company adopted the name EMI Electrola in 1972. E.G. is a record-series designation rather than an organization name.

sources.fullCitation: Marek Weber und sein Orchester, refrain credited as Leo Moll. “Signorina aus Brioni.” Tango; label credits Fritz Rotter and Dr. Kaper for music and text. Electrola E.G. 2400, n.d. Shellac disc, Radiomuseum Hardthausen / Schallarchiv; filmed-label transfer on YouTube. Accessed 20 August 2026.
sources.title: Signorina aus Brioni — Electrola E.G. 2400
sources.creator: Marek Weber und sein Orchester, Refrain: Leo Moll
sources.researchNote: The uploader identifies the singer credited as Leo Moll as Leo Monosson, gives 1931 as the issue year and accompanies the transfer with a 1930 photograph of Brioni. These details are not printed on the filmed label.
